title: Slow progress and the thieving monkey
summary: Years pass and Zhang Xiaofan still makes slow progress on Great Bamboo Peak. Tian Buyi thinks he lacks determination and wishes he were steady like bamboo, and soon after Xiaofan finally breaks through the first level, to his seniors' delight, though Tian Buyi only tells him to go and cook. On Dragon Head Peak, Lin Jingyu has reached the sixth level of the Taiji Xuanqing method after five years, taught by Cang Song himself. Fang Chao challenges him and is nearly killed, and senior disciple Qi Hao scolds Fang Chao for looking down on his junior. Back on Great Bamboo Peak, Xiaofan has become the peak's cook, and a monkey keeps stealing his food. Tian Ling'er chases it with him into an unknown part of the mountain, where Xiaofan loses all his strength and finds her unconscious. He then sees something strange.
